metadata.question: Does the burned area extent in Acre, Brazil increase in late September 2005 compared to late July 2005?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Acre, Brazil (need to define geometry for this state) - Time periods: Late July 2005 (e.g., July 20-31) vs Late September 2005 (e.g., Sept 20-30) - Collection: MODIS Burned Area product (MCD64A1) is ideal for burned area detection, or we can use thermal anomaly data (FIRMS) or calculate burned area from Landsat using NBR 2. Masking strategy: - For burned area products like MCD64A1, we want to count pixels that indicate burned areas - No cloud masking needed for burned area product as it already processes this - We're looking at total burned area extent, so we'll sum up burned pixels 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero (B): If burned area in Sept ≤ July, answer is "No" (B) - Valid Increase (A): If burned area in Sept > July, answer is "Yes" (A) - C1: If no images found for either period - C2: If images exist but all pixels are masked/invalid - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN I'll use MCD64A1 burned area product which provides monthly burned area at 500m resolution. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Acre, Brazil geometry const acre = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level1') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM1_NAME', 'Acre')) .geometry(); // 2. Define time periods const julyStart = '2005-07-20'; const julyEnd = '2005-07-31'; const septStart = '2005-09-20'; const septEnd = '2005-09-30'; // 3. Load MODIS Burned Area product const julyCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD64A1') .filterBounds(acre) .filterDate(julyStart, julyEnd); const septCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD64A1') .filterBounds(acre) .filterDate(septStart, septEnd); const julySize = julyCol.size().getInfo(); const septSize = septCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`July images: ${julySize}, Sept images: ${septSize}`); // 4. Check for empty collections if (julySize === 0 || septSize === 0) { console.log('Empty collection for one or both periods.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 5. Process burned area (BurnDate band > 0 indicates burned) const julyImg = julyCol.first(); const septImg = septCol.first(); // BurnDate band: day of year when burned (1-366), 0 = not burned const julyBurned = julyImg.select('BurnDate').gt(0); const septBurned = septImg.select('BurnDate').gt(0); // 6. Calculate burned area extent (count of burned pixels) const julyStats = julyBurned.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: acre, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const septStats = septBurned.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: acre, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const julyCount = julyStats.get('BurnDate').getInfo(); const septCount = septStats.get('BurnDate').getInfo(); // 7. Also get total pixel counts to check for C2 const julyTotal = julyImg.select('BurnDate').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: acre, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('BurnDate').getInfo(); const septTotal = septImg.select('BurnDate').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: acre, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('BurnDate').getInfo(); console.log(`July: ${julyCount} burned pixels out of ${julyTotal} total`); console.log(`Sept: ${septCount} burned pixels out of ${septTotal} total`); // 8. Validation if (julyTotal === 0 || septTotal === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (julyCount === null || septCount === null || typeof julyCount === 'undefined' || typeof septCount === 'undefined') { console.log('Calculation failed - null/undefined result.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 9. Calculate burned area in km² const pixelArea = 500 * 500 / 1e6; // 0.25 km² const julyArea = julyCount * pixelArea; const septArea = septCount * pixelArea; console.log(`July burned area: ${julyArea.toFixed(2)} km²`); console.log(`Sept burned area: ${septArea.toFixed(2)} km²`); // 10. Final answer if (septArea > julyArea) { console.log('Burned area increased from July to September.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Burned area did not increase from July to September.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
